headline: SJVN Limited reports change in directors
summary: SJVN Limited has notified the NSE of a change in its board of directors. The announcement lists the new directors who will join the existing board. This is a routine corporate governance update and does not alter the company’s operations or financials. Investors may note the change for future board decisions.
why_it_matters: Board composition update may influence company strategy

headline: SJVN appoints Raman Gharsanghi as part-time official director
hook: Leadership refresh at state-owned power generator
summary: State-owned power producer SJVN has announced the appointment of Raman Gharsanghi as its part-time official director. The board change brings a new government nominee to the company's leadership structure. SJVN operates across hydro, solar, and thermal power generation segments in India. Routine board appointments of official directors typically have a neutral impact on day-to-day share price movement for retail investors.
why_it_matters: Routine board change with no immediate impact on stock price

headline: SJVN appoints Raman Gharsanghi as Non-Executive Nominee Director
hook: New nominee director joins SJVN board
summary: SJVN Limited has announced the appointment of Mr. Raman Gharsanghi as a Non-Executive Nominee Director effective October 12, 2026. Nominee directors represent specific stakeholder interests, such as government bodies or institutional investors, on the company's board. For retail investors, board composition changes are routine corporate governance updates that generally have no immediate impact on daily stock price movement.
why_it_matters: Board changes have no immediate impact on your holdings.

headline: 13 major public sector stocks drop to 52-week lows
summary: Thirteen CPSE stocks, including ONGC, NTPC, and BEL, touched 52-week lows during Thursday's intraday trading. Other affected companies include Power Grid, NMDC, IREDA, IRFC, RCF, RVNL, SJVN, and Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders. This broad decline reflects a significant cooling in investor sentiment toward the public sector space. The sell-off spans across energy, power, defense, and railway infrastructure sectors.
why_it_matters: PSU portfolio valuations face significant downward pressure
